sloka: तयोरथ महान् कालो व्यत्ययाद्युध्यमानयोः।न च तौ युद्धवैमुख्यं श्रमं वाप्युपजग्मतुः ।। ६.८९.४१ ।।
transliteration: tayoratha mahān kālo vyatyayādyudhyamānayoḥ।na ca tau yuddhavaimukhyaṁ śramaṁ vāpyupajagmatuḥ ।। 6.89.41 ।।

translations.english: Both of them, bodies wet with blood and covered with arrows were glowing like fire and appeared bright.
